name: Adani Enterprises

snapshot.about: Adani Enterprises Limited operates an infrastructure-focused incubator portfolio spanning energy, utilities, transport, logistics, and primary industry.

narrative: Management targeted aggressive capital expenditure and volume expansions, successfully scaling airport passenger traffic close to expectations. However, total income growth plateaued relative to historical gains, and cumulative cash generation remained negative despite reported operational profits.

promises.statement: Targeting capex of just over INR 36,000 crores in FY26.

said.quote: d we are on track in the following year of roughly around just over INR 36,000 crores.

actual_source.quote: our total target that we had outlined was roughly INR36,000 crores

promises.statement: Expect full-year FY26 passenger traffic just short of 100 million.

said.quote: we expect around number just short of 100 million for the year

actual_source.quote: Financial performance during '25-'26, we had passenger traffic of 95.3 million passengers, total income of INR13,081 crores, up by 28% year-over-year

promises.statement: Phase 2 capex for Navi Mumbai Airport will be in the tune of INR 30,000 crore.

said.quote: We will restart, and it will be in the tune of INR30,000 crores

promises.statement: Total capex outlay planned for city side development is around INR 20,000 crore.

said.quote: So, the total capex outlay for the city side we have is around INR20,000 crores

promises.statement: Navi Mumbai Airport, Kutch Copper, and Ganga Expressway will together contribute INR 6,000–6,800 crores peak EBITDA.

said.quote: overall, these businesses will contribute at peak capacity somewhere between INR6,000 crores to INR6,800 crores

promises.statement: Expected return rate on Navi Mumbai Airport assets is between 12% and 14%.

said.quote: expected rate of return on assets of this type is in the range of 12% to 14%

promises.statement: Navi Mumbai Airport, Kutch Copper, and Ganga Expressway are expected to add over INR 3,000 crores EBITDA in FY27.

said.quote: In the next fiscal year, AEL is set to unlock EBITDA from Navi Mumbai Airport, Kutch Copper and Ganga Expressway, which are expected to add over INR3,000 crores EBITDA to AEL

promises.statement: Management expects FY27 capital expenditure to be around INR 40,000 crores.

said.quote: We expect the next year to be around the same level, about INR40,000 crores

promises.statement: Airports business capex for FY27 will be approximately INR 17,000 crores.

said.quote: And of that, there are 3 core areas where the capex is, especially airports, which will be roughly, give or take, about INR17,000 crores

promises.statement: Management expects high double-digit volume growth around 20% in Mining Services next fiscal year.

said.quote: You can expect that we will be high double-digit growth next year as well. So say close to 20% mark

promises.statement: Mining services dispatch volumes expected to reach close to 60 MMT over the next 18 months.

said.quote: we expect that we will be closer to 60 over the next 18 months based on the current demand patterns

promises.statement: New 6 GW solar cell and module lines expected ready by 30th September 2026.

said.quote: The new lines would be expected to be ready by 30th September this year

promises.statement: Total capex required for 6 GW cell and module project is INR 10,000 crores.

said.quote: The total capex for this project is around INR10,000 crores and it is on schedule completion

promises.statement: Capex for the green hydrogen ecosystem will be roughly INR 5,500 crores in FY26.

said.quote: Green hydrogen ecosystem will be roughly 5,500

promises.statement: Capex for airports will be roughly INR 10,500 crores in FY26.
Capex for roads will be roughly INR 6,200 crores in FY26.
Continuing work on the PVC business will add another INR 9,000 crores to capex in FY26.

said.quote: And then we expect the continuing work on PVC to add another about 9,000 to the capex

promises.statement: Expensed capex on coal-to-PVC business is around INR 9,000 crores.

said.quote: currently, our capex that has already been expensed on that business is in the vicinity of about INR9,000 crores

cash.read: Operating cash flows covered reported profits over the five-year period, but intensive ongoing investments caused free cash flow to remain deeply negative.

bull.point: Airport sector showed robust growth with passenger traffic reaching 95.3 million and segment EBITDA surging significantly.

evidence.quote: Financial performance during '25-'26, we had passenger traffic of 95.3 million passengers, total income of INR13,081 crores, up by 28% year-over-year
and EBITDA increased by 55% to INR5,394 crores on account of tariff revisions and non-aero growth

bull.point: Mining services maintained steady dispatch volume growth alongside expanding revenues and positive EBITDA contributions.

evidence.quote: During the year, the dispatch volume was up by 14% to 49.4 MMT, revenue up by 20% to INR4,536 crores and EBITDA up by 18% to INR1,986 crores

bull.point: The company successfully completed a large rights issue to support capital-intensive incubating infrastructure projects.

evidence.quote: we completed the rights issue raising INR24,930 crores

bear.point: Free cash flow was negative across four out of five years, indicating severe cash outflows.

evidence.quote: Free cash flow was negative in 4 of 5 years, −₹75,217 crore in total.
evidence.source: Computed from screener.in's cash-flow statement and ratios

bear.point: Rising inventory days show cash is increasingly tied up within working capital.

evidence.quote: Inventory days rose from 69 to 126 between FY24 and FY26: cash is waiting longer in the business.
evidence.source: Computed from screener.in's cash-flow statement and ratios

bear.point: Auditors noted that revenue recognition and coal inventory measurements involve critical estimates and significant management judgment.

evidence.quote: Material estimation by the Company is involved in recognition and measurement of its revenue

notes: Q1 FY27 results are out, but that quarter's call transcript is not filed yet, so its guidance is not here.
